name: etc_oxphos
description: Electron Transport Chain + Oxidative Phosphorylation. Electrons from NADH and FADH₂ flow through Complexes I–IV, creating a proton gradient that drives ATP synthesis via ATP synthase.

nodes.label: NADH
nodes.notes: Primary electron donor from TCA, β-oxidation, PDH, etc.

nodes.label: FADH₂
nodes.notes: Electron donor from succinate dehydrogenase (Complex II) and acyl-CoA dehydrogenase.

nodes.label: Complex I (NADH Dehydrogenase)
nodes.notes: Accepts electrons from NADH, pumps 4 H⁺.

nodes.label: Complex II (Succinate Dehydrogenase)
nodes.notes: Accepts electrons from FADH₂ / succinate. Does NOT pump protons.

nodes.label: Coenzyme Q (Ubiquinone)
nodes.notes: Mobile lipid-soluble carrier. Accepts electrons from I and II.

nodes.label: Complex III (Cytochrome bc₁)
nodes.notes: Transfers electrons from QH₂ to cytochrome c. Pumps 4 H⁺ (Q-cycle).

nodes.label: Cytochrome c
nodes.notes: Mobile peripheral membrane protein. Carries one electron at a time.

nodes.label: Complex IV (Cytochrome c Oxidase)
nodes.notes: Transfers electrons to O₂, forming H₂O. Pumps 2 H⁺.

nodes.label: Proton Gradient (Δp)
nodes.notes: Electrochemical gradient across the inner mitochondrial membrane (intermembrane space positive/acidic).

nodes.label: ATP Synthase (Complex V)
nodes.notes: Uses the proton-motive force to drive ATP synthesis from ADP + Pi.

edges.notes: NADH donates 2 electrons. 4 protons pumped to intermembrane space.
Electrons transferred to ubiquinone, forming ubiquinol (QH₂).
FADH₂ / succinate electrons enter here. No protons pumped at Complex II.
Electrons from FADH₂ also reduce CoQ.
Q-cycle results in 4 protons translocated per 2 electrons.
One electron at a time is passed to cytochrome c.
Cyt c delivers electrons to Complex IV.
4 electrons + 4 H⁺ + O₂ → 2 H₂O. 2 protons pumped.
Protons flow back into the matrix through ATP synthase, driving ATP synthesis (chemiosmosis).
ADP + Pi → ATP. Approximate yield: 2.5 ATP per NADH, 1.5 ATP per FADH₂.
